name: ascension to walmart
author: vayulena
description: NOTE: YOU MUST CLICK THE GREEN ORB AT 29%. Hold to the second structure at 30% to go above the cube portal at 30% and stay as the mini wave. Navigate through the following section as the wave until 33% where you can enter the normal size portal and go above the level. Stay near the ceiling for the rest of the level. Be very close to the ceiling at 92% to avoid an end wall.
